meta.notes: A pig sound variant: adult_sounds and baby_sounds name the sound event of each noise a grown pig and a piglet make. This one grunts like the vanilla big pig and squeals like the mini pig when hurt. The pig keeps it in its minecraft:pig/sound_variant component. Each value is a vanilla sound event id; a sound of your own needs the object form { "sound_id": "<namespace>:<event>" }.
